data_scope: Real daily counts reconstructed from raw ITSM opening timestamps; synthetic rows are excluded from evaluation and, for this track, from training.
prediction_time: End of calendar day t, for workload on day t+1.

observable_target.definition: 1 when the real all-incident opening count on target day t+1 is at or above a capacity threshold frozen as the empirical 80th percentile of real daily counts from 2023-01-01 through 2025-06-30; otherwise 0.
observable_target.reason: A high-volume day is observable from opening timestamps and directly supports next-day staffing/flex-capacity decisions.
observable_target.threshold_ties: Use >= against the frozen numeric threshold; never recompute the threshold on July-December evaluation data.

baseline.name: seasonal_naive_lag7
baseline.score: Real incident count on target day minus 7 days, available by prediction time.
baseline.reason: It is the simplest defensible next-day workload ranking that captures day-of-week seasonality and matches the active seasonal-naive forecasting logic.

evaluation.training_rule: For each month, fit using target days strictly before the first day of the month and features available by the preceding day.
evaluation.primary_metric: Pooled out-of-fold average precision (PR-AUC) across identical real July-December 2025 target days.
evaluation.paired_improvement_gate: Candidate pooled PR-AUC must be at least 15% higher than seasonal_naive_lag7 on the exact same rows.
evaluation.temporal_stability_gate: Candidate must win monthly PR-AUC in at least 4 of 6 folds and beat the baseline on pooled PR-AUC in both 2025-07..09 and 2025-10..12.
evaluation.seed_stability_gate: For stochastic candidates, evaluate seeds 11, 29, 47, 71, and 101; mean performance must pass, every seed must retain at least a 10% paired gain, and relative PR-AUC spread (max-min)/mean must be <= 10%.
secondary_metrics: days reviewed per true high-workload day
evaluation.workload_protocol: Report capacity-matched Top-20% ranking metrics per fold (ceil(20% of days)); this is a workload diagnostic, not a retrospectively tuned deployment threshold.
evaluation.operational_guardrail: At Top-20% workload, pooled recall must not be more than 5% relatively below the baseline and precision must not be lower than the baseline.

operational_action: At the end of each day, issue a next-day staffing advisory when the risk score crosses a threshold calibrated only on prior real days. The advisory supports flex staffing/on-call readiness; it does not automate incident handling. A Top-20% budget corresponds to at most roughly one advisory in five days and is used here to quantify workload.
promotion_label_policy: Only a candidate satisfying every predeclared gate can be called promotion-worthy for this track.
